_review_checklist: Compare every line against the photograph, not against the app.
Chord rows are monospaced: a chord's character column IS its position, so keep the alignment when you edit a lyric.
Write chords exactly as the page prints them - em, H7, -7, fiszm. Storage spelling is the app's job, not this file's.
warnings holds slugs, not prose: low-resolution, show-through-removed, two-songs, no-chords, german-chords, nothing-legible.
Put your name in reviewed_by when the text matches the page. Until you do, every score against this file is circular.
_stresses: TWO competing chord sets on one page: printed (Dm, G7, B, A, Gm, A7, Asus4) and handwritten in blue pen a whole tone up (Em, A7, C, H, Am, H7, Hsus4)
which set the user wants is a product decision, not an OCR setting - this page is why tier C exists
printed chords use superscript quality: D with superscript m, A with superscript sus4, A with superscript 7
B in this book means B flat, and the handwritten C above it confirms the transposition - so the H-is-B rule must not fire on the printed B
stage directions inline with chords: - Intro x1, - Intro
verse 2 has no chord rows and must inherit verse 1 chords by line position (chord_carry.dart)
the header and first staff of song 110 (Te veled) are visible at the bottom edge
